behaviours.name: Runs everything on WhatsApp
behaviours.how: Customers message you, you forward jobs to a technicians' WhatsApp group, and photos and updates come back by chat.

behaviours.name: Price-first
behaviours.how: Uses free tools wherever possible and compares every paid tool with the cheapest one you have heard of.

behaviours.name: Tried an app before
behaviours.how: Paid for a job-tracking app once; the technicians stopped using it within weeks and you went back to calls and WhatsApp.

behaviours.name: Buys on recommendation
behaviours.how: Only tries something a trusted fellow owner, distributor or relative already uses.

behaviours.name: Brand service partner
behaviours.how: Does authorised service for one or two AC brands, which make you log their jobs in the brand's own system; your own customers are tracked separately.

behaviours.name: Does the paperwork at night
behaviours.how: Spends evenings calling technicians and writing up job details, bills and AMC dates yourself.

pitch:
AITechnician Founding Shop Plan, for AC and appliance service companies in Chennai.
After each job, your technician presses one button and says what was done, in Tamil, English or a mix. The app writes the service report: the problem, the work done, the parts changed (with a photo of the old part) and the time taken. The technician or you check it with one tap, and only then does it go to the customer on WhatsApp.
You see every job of the day on one screen, and AMC renewal reminders go out to your customers on their own.
One flat price for the whole shop: ₹999 a month for up to 10 technicians, ₹2,499 for up to 25, ₹4,499 for up to 50. No setup fee, cancel any time.
You pay nothing until your team is actually using it. The first month is free, and you only start paying if your technicians sent at least 7 out of 10 of their jobs through the app in the last two weeks of that month. Your job and AMC records stay yours: download them to Excel any time, and you get a full copy if you leave.
The founder sets up every shop in person, at your office, and gives you a direct phone number for problems. The plan is open to 10 founding shops, set up during the quiet months before the summer rush, and their price stays fixed for two years.
